full_prompt_en: A square atmospheric painting shows a broad pale winter ground, a dark reflective channel cutting into it, and a solitary small figure standing before a distant house with lit windows. The scene is seen from a slightly raised viewpoint, with the foreground dominated by geometric fields of muted teal and near-black. Across the upper strip, a line of thin leafless trees marks the horizon beneath a deep green-gray sky. A low rectangular house sits just right of center, its roof and chimneys silhouetted against the haze. Several small windows glow warm yellow, a tiny concentrated warmth in the otherwise cold image. Slightly below the house, the lone upright figure stands near the far edge of the pale ground, reduced to a dark vertical mark with a faint reflection or shadow beneath. A wide pale horizontal band stretches across the middle, separating the remote house from the strong shapes below. From the left foreground, a long black wedge narrows toward a point near the figure. Beside it, a cool turquoise surface carries a blurred inverted echo of the bright windows and dark house. On the right, a second deep shadow block reaches up from the bottom edge, creating a hard vertical boundary where it meets the reflective area. The rest of the foreground is smooth and sparse, with only faint rubbed or scratched texture disturbing its color. The light is low and diffuse, seemingly coming from the pale open middle distance and the distant windows; broad dark areas swallow local detail rather than revealing cast shadows. Edges of the main wedges are clean, while distant trees and architecture soften in mist. No readable text appears. The overall composition turns a small figure and warm rectangular lights into a lonely focal point within expansive cold geometry and still reflective depth.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形大气感绘画呈现宽阔浅色冬季地面、一条切入其中的深色反光水道，以及一位站在远处亮灯房屋前的小小孤影。画面采用略高的视点，前景主要由低调青绿色与近黑色几何色域构成。上方窄带，一排纤细落叶树在深绿灰色天空下标出地平线。中央稍右有一座低矮矩形房屋，屋顶和烟囱在薄雾前呈剪影。数扇小窗发出暖黄光，是整个寒冷画面里很小却集中的暖色。房屋稍下方，孤独的站姿人物位于浅色地面的远端，缩成一道深色竖痕，脚下有隐约倒影或影子。一条宽阔浅色水平带横贯中部，将远方房屋与下方强烈形体隔开。从左前景出发，一道长长的黑色楔形向人物附近收成尖端。其旁，冷青绿色表面映出明亮窗户和深色房屋的模糊倒影。右侧第二片深影从底边升起，在与反光区相遇处形成硬直边界。其余前景平滑而稀疏，只有轻微擦磨或划痕扰动色面。光低而漫射，似乎来自中距离开阔浅色区域和远方窗户；大片黑暗吞没局部细节，而不是显露复杂投影。主要楔形边缘清楚，远处树木与建筑则在雾中柔化。没有可读文字。整体构图让小人物与暖色矩形灯光成为孤独焦点，置于广阔冷色几何形和静止反光纵深之间。
style_prompt_en: The image has an atmospheric, pared-back painted finish organized by large geometric darks, cool translucent midtones, and tiny warm lights. Deep blue-green, muted turquoise, charcoal, and pale gray dominate; a few amber-yellow accents become unusually powerful because the surrounding field is so restrained. Long tapering diagonals and abrupt straight boundaries create a path through otherwise broad horizontal stillness. Surface texture is faintly rubbed and grainy, with distant forms softened by haze and nearby mass edges held clean. Low diffuse illumination leaves shadows as substantial flat areas and lets reflected light form a narrow, quiet depth cue. A tiny vertical accent is set against sweeping negative space, making scale and solitude central to the visual rhythm. The overall effect is hushed, nocturnal, and quietly uncanny.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有大气感、简约的绘画完成面，由大片几何深色、冷而半透明的中间色和极小暖光组织。深蓝绿、低调青绿、炭黑和浅灰占主导；少量琥珀黄强调因周围色域克制而格外有力。狭长收尖的斜线和突然的直边在宽阔水平静止感中开出一条路径。表面肌理有轻微擦磨与颗粒，远处形体被薄雾柔化，近处大块边缘保持清楚。低位漫射光让阴影成为分量足的平面，也让反光构成狭窄安静的纵深线索。极小的竖向强调置于广阔负空间前，使尺度与孤独成为视觉节奏的中心。整体效果寂静、夜色浓重，并带不安的奇异感。
theme_en: A lone figure across a winter field from a lit house, with a dark reflective channel
theme_zh: 冬季空地上的孤影、亮灯房屋与深色倒影水道
name: Leon Spilliaert
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
